raw.query: SELECT fc.rho, count(distinct (fc.window_name, fc.lead_s)) FILTER (WHERE fc.feasible = true) as passes, count(distinct (fc.window_name, fc.lead_s)) as total FROM provenance.factorial_cell fc WHERE fc.policy = 'reactive' AND fc.window_name != 'aggregate' AND fc.lead_s IN (15, 30, 45, 300) GROUP BY fc.rho ORDER BY fc.rho;
raw.observed: rho 10: 14/20 passes; rho 15: 14/20 passes; rho 20: 13/20 passes; rho 25: 13/20 passes
raw.claimed: The reactive policy, by contrast, is insensitive to rho (13-14 of 20 cells at every rating).
raw.evidence: In factorial_cell, the reactive policy (excluding aggregate) has exactly 20 unique (window, lead) cells at each of the four rho values; feasible cells are exactly 14/20 for rho=10, 14/20 for rho=15, 13/20 for rho=20, and 13/20 for rho=25. Prior verifier GPT-5.6-sol erred by blindly filtering on runs.is_current, which excluded target-time reactive runs (which are marked is_current=false to isolate issue-time forecast runs in current_factorial).
